Apple Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.63 (AAPL) Posted by Donald Scott | Feb 2nd, 2018 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) announced a quarterly dividend on Thursday, February 1st, RTT News reports. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be given a dividend of 0.63 per share by the iPhone maker on Thursday, February 15th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.50%. 
Apple has increased its dividend by an average of 10.1% annually over the last three years and has increased its dividend annually for the last 5 consecutive years. Apple has a dividend payout ratio of 22.5% meaning its dividend is sufficiently covered by earnings. Equities analysts expect Apple to earn $11.78 per share next year, which means the company should continue to be able to cover its $2.52 annual dividend with an expected future payout ratio of 21.4%. Shares of Apple ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $167.78 on Friday. The company has a market capitalization of $861,430.00, a P/E ratio of 18.26, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.36 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. Apple has a 12 month low of $127.78 and a 12 month high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $3.75 by $0.14. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 36.29% and a net margin of 21.09%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business posted $3.36 EPS. equities research analysts expect that Apple will post 11.13 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
